info.desc: Hopelessness (stylized as HOPELESSNESS) is the debut solo album from Anohni, the lead singer of Antony and the Johnsons, released on Secretly Canadian and Rough Trade Records. It features co-production by musicians Ross Birchard (aka Hudson Mohawke) and Daniel Lopatin (aka Oneohtrix Point Never), with additional production and engineering by Paul Corley. Bianca & Sierra Casady (aka CocoRosie) provide additional vocals on 'Violent Men'. .
